not_read: other Obad proposals or review artifacts

non_authority_statement: Candidate literary/form evidence only. No theology, canon, authorship, date, historicity, Edom/Esau/Jacob identity beyond the wording, violence ethics, day-of-YHWH chronology, territorial program, fulfillment, preferred witness/reading/translation/source tradition, graph, retrieval, promotion, or reviewed-gold authority.
routing_principle: Prefer sustained oracle movements: vision-and-embassy humiliation, plunder-and-betrayal collapse, repeated-day violence accusation, proportional day reversal, Zion escape and house-fire reversal, and territorial possession register through kingdom closure. Split only at strong discourse, accusation, day-formula, reversal, or list-function seams; preserve similes, repeated prohibitions, territorial lists, and closing formulae within their larger rhetorical units.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: vision and embassy overture followed by Edom humiliation, plunder, betrayal, and collapse
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Second-person address, downward reversal, ransacking comparisons, ally betrayal, and wisdom-warrior loss sustain the complete Edom-humiliation parent.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: violence accusation, repeated-day prohibitions, universal day formula, and proportional reversal
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: The causal accusation at verse 10 unfolds through the cumulative in-the-day chain and reaches its reciprocal day verdict in verses 15-16.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: Zion escape, house-fire reversal, territorial possession register, and kingdom closure
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Escape and possession language begins the closing reversal, the fire image intensifies it, and the territorial register culminates in the ascent and kingdom line.

global_hot_zones.issue: The vision formula, reported embassy, divine speech, second-person address, and pride-to-descent movement can be separated at several plausible seams.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep the compact overture and humiliation address together; defer speaker quotation punctuation, event, nation, authorship, date, and source questions.

global_hot_zones.issue: Thief, grape-gatherer, ransacking, alliance, bread, snare, and understanding language is image-dense and translation-sensitive.
global_hot_zones.handling: Preserve the cumulative plunder-and-betrayal movement; choose no preferred lexical, syntactic, or witness reading.

global_hot_zones.issue: Day formula, wisdom loss, warrior dismay, and slaughter language could either close verses 5-9 or begin the next day complex.
global_hot_zones.handling: Close the humiliation parent here while retaining 1:5-9 and 1:1-9 as exact larger alternatives; keep the seam LOW/deferred.

global_hot_zones.issue: The causal violence accusation and repeated 'in the day' and 'do not' clauses invite atomization and historical-event identification.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep the full accusation chain together; defer historical referent, chronology, ethics, and the temporal force of the prohibitions.

global_hot_zones.issue: The day-of-YHWH formula widens from the addressed party to all nations, while drinking imagery and pronouns are difficult.
global_hot_zones.handling: Preserve the proportional-reversal couplet; choose no referent, chronology, fulfillment, ethics, or preferred translation.

global_hot_zones.issue: Escape, holiness, possession, house identities, fire/stubble violence, and no-remnant wording carry dense theological and fulfillment pressure.
global_hot_zones.handling: Treat them only as a coordinated reversal movement; defer identities, ethics, doctrine, territorial outcome, and fulfillment.

global_hot_zones.issue: The possession register contains difficult geography and syntax before the saviors/judges ascent and kingdom close.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep the whole register and close together; decide no geography, political program, identity, fulfillment, or preferred wording.

anti_oversplit_guards.guard: Do not isolate the superscription, embassy report, pride question, eagle comparison, or descent verdict from the compact overture.
Do not split each comparison, ally action, wisdom reference, warrior line, or closing result.
Do not split each repeated day phrase, prohibition, gate action, crossroads action, or escaped/remnant group.
Do not detach the universal day formula from as-you-did reciprocity and the drinking comparison.
Do not isolate escape, holiness, possession, each named house, fire, flame, stubble, remnant, or speech close.
Do not atomize each place, people, possession clause, savior/judge, mountain, or final kingdom statement.

units.title: Vision and embassy overture with pride brought down
units.literary_form: vision superscription, reported summons, direct address, and humiliation oracle
units.deciding_marker: The vision-and-embassy report opens the oracle and immediately yields to a sustained second-person pride-to-descent address; the thief comparison at verse 5 begins a new plunder movement.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 1:1 as a title, split the embassy from the address, or detach the eagle-and-stars comparison from the descent verdict.
units.risk: Speaker punctuation, embassy setting, Edom identity beyond the wording, authorship, date, event, pride terminology, and witness choices remain deferred.

units.title: Plunder, ally betrayal, and wisdom-warrior collapse
units.literary_form: rhetorical comparison sequence and cumulative humiliation oracle
units.deciding_marker: Thief and grape-gatherer questions launch the ransacking sequence; ally betrayal leads into the explicit 'in that day' loss of wisdom and warriors, completing the collapse before the causal accusation at verse 10.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split thieves from grape gatherers, ransacking from ally betrayal, or wisdom from warrior dismay; retain the complete 1:1-9 humiliation parent as an alternative.
units.risk: Difficult syntax in verses 5-7, quotation boundaries, bread/snare wording, agency, day reference, violence, and preferred translation remain deferred.

units.title: Violence accusation through the repeated-day prohibitions
units.literary_form: causal indictment and cumulative accusation-prohibition chain
units.deciding_marker: 'For the violence' names the charge, verse 11 establishes the day setting, and the repeated 'do not' and calamity/distress formulas accumulate the acts through the crossroads and remnant line.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach the charge from its narrated setting or atomize each day clause, prohibition, gate, wealth, crossroads, escapee, or remnant.
units.risk: Historical event, temporal perspective, addressee identity, brother/Jacob referent beyond the wording, violence ethics, forever language, and translation remain deferred.

units.title: Day-of-YHWH proportional reversal among the nations
units.literary_form: universalizing day announcement and reciprocal judgment comparison
units.deciding_marker: 'For the day of Yahweh' pivots from the repeated accusation days to a widened announcement; as-you-did and as-you-drank comparisons form one proportional-reversal movement before Zion's contrasting escape at verse 17.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate the day formula, reciprocity statement, holy-mountain drinking image, or nations' outcome; preserve 10-16 as the larger accusation-and-reversal parent.
units.risk: Day chronology, pronoun referents, drinking imagery, holy-mountain reference, violence ethics, duration, fulfillment, and preferred reading remain deferred.

units.title: Zion escape, possession, and house-fire reversal
units.literary_form: contrastive restoration-reversal oracle with fire imagery
units.deciding_marker: 'But in Mount Zion' opens the contrast; escape, holiness, and possession continue into the parallel houses of fire, flame, and stubble, ending with the speech-confirmation formula.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach Zion escape from possession or atomize Jacob, Joseph, Esau, fire, flame, stubble, remnant, and speech formula; retain 17-21 as a larger close.
units.risk: Holiness, house identities, possession referent, violent image, no-remnant wording, ethics, doctrine, political-territorial claims, fulfillment, and preferred translation remain deferred.

units.title: Territorial possession register and kingdom closure
units.literary_form: geographic possession register culminating in ascent and kingdom acclamation
units.deciding_marker: The repeated possession clauses begin a list-function movement across places and groups; the ascent to judge and final kingdom clause provide its climax and book closure.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split each territory, people, captive group, city, ascent, judgment clause, or final kingdom line; preserve the complete 17-21 restoration-and-close parent as an alternative.
units.risk: Geography, difficult syntax, named-group identity, savior/judge translation, mountain referents, territorial or political program, fulfillment, theology, and preferred witness remain deferred.
